data.title: HUTCHMED Presents Preclinical HMPL-A830 Data at Cancer Research Conference
data.description:

data.title: HBM Holdings Announces NMPA Acceptance of LET003 IND Application
data.description:
HBM Holdings Ltd. ( (HK:2142) ) has issued an announcement.

HBM Holdings develops monoclonal antibody drug candidates, including LET003 for overweight or obesity, using its Hu-mAtrIx™ AI platform.

China’s NMPA accepted the IND application for LET003, the company’s first AI-enabled drug candidate and a dual ACVR2A/ACVR2B blocker. In preclinical studies, LET003 showed superior pharmacokinetic characteristics versus multiple competitor molecules and, when combined with semaglutide, enhanced fat reduction while preserving lean mass.

data.title: Listing Committee Upholds Decision to Suspend Goldstone Capital Shares
data.description:
Youth Champ Financial Group Holdings Limited ( (HK:1160) ) just unveiled an announcement.

The Listing Committee upheld the Stock Exchange’s decision to suspend trading in Goldstone Capital Group’s shares after finding that the company had not maintained sufficient operations and assets of sufficient value to support its operations under Rule 13.24. The decision followed a 10 November 2026 hearing and was communicated to the company on 18 November 2026.

During the five-year review period, the company’s financial assets ranged from nil to HK$6.6 million at year-end and consisted mainly of short-term U.S. treasury bills and debt securities, with no evidence of active investment activities or portfolio management. The Listing Committee also found that the company lacked the established management and operational infrastructure necessary for a substantive investment operation.

data.title: CSRC Approves Registration of Orient Securities’ Proposed Shanghai Securities Acquisition
data.description:
Orient Securities Co., Ltd. Class H ( (HK:3958) ) has provided an update.

Orient Securities Co., Ltd. received China Securities Regulatory Commission approval to register its proposed acquisition of 100% of Shanghai Securities. The transaction involves issuing specified consideration A shares to Bailian Group, Guotai Haitong, SIG Investment, SIG and Shanghai Chengtou Group, alongside a cash payment, and approves Orient Securities becoming the actual controller of Xinjiang Qianhai Alliance Asset Management and Hicend Futures.

The approval authorizes Bailian Group and SIG and entities under its control to become major shareholders of Orient Securities following the share exchange. It also requires risk segregation, controls on related-party transactions and conflicts of interest, orderly integration, client and employee protections, amended constitutional documents, and timely completion of required issuance and disclosure procedures.
